mapper.select: SELECT W.wishlist_id AS wishlistId, W.member_id AS memberId, W.product_id AS productId, W.package_id AS packageId, DATE_FORMAT(W.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, CASE WHEN W.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PRODUCT' ELSE 'PACKAGE' END AS itemType, IFNULL(P.product_name, PK.package_name) AS itemName, IFNULL(P.price, PK.package_price) AS price, IFNULL(P.product_status, PK.package_status) AS itemStatus, P.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, PK.package_grade AS packageGrade, CASE WHEN W.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT PI.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.product_id = W.product_id AND PI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PI.display_order ASC, PI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE ( SELECT PKI.image_url FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PKI WHERE PKI.package_id = W.package_id AND PKI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PKI.display_order ASC, PKI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) END AS thumbnailUrl FROM WISHLIST W LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON W.product_id = P.product_id LEFT JOIN PACKAGE PK ON W.package_id = PK.package_id WHERE W.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY W.wishlist_id DESC
SELECT wishlist_id FROM WISHLIST WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND package_id IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT wishlist_id FROM WISHLIST WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND package_id = #{packageId} AND product_id IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WISHLIST ( member_id, product_id, package_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{packageId}, NOW() )
